name: Guest Sheet + RSVP API (GET/POST with Slug)
description: Migrate guest data from static lib/guests.ts to Google Sheets with a build-time fetch script. Add slug-aware RSVP AppScript (GET last response by slug + POST append with slug). RSVP form pre-fills for returning guests who visit via personalized link.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm fetch-guests writes lib/guests-generated.json from GUEST_SCRIPT_URL
pnpm fetch-guests fails with clear error when GUEST_SCRIPT_URL is unset
lib/guests.ts exports same GuestMap/getGuestById API as before
/?g=<slug> with prior RSVP: form pre-filled with last submission
/?g=<slug> with no prior RSVP: form empty, works normally
/ (no slug): form empty, POST has no slug field
GET failure silently ignored, form stays empty
pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build all pass
notes: messages per guest remain hardcoded in GUEST_MESSAGES in lib/guests.ts. Commit lib/guests-generated.json to repo so Vercel builds without needing GUEST_SCRIPT_URL at build time.
